Two people were sitting together at dinner talking about the diets they had just recently started as part of their new year's resolution this year, one skinny and the other obese. The skinny friend was optimistic about continuing the diet, as it had been going pretty well so far, but the obese person wasn't optimistic at all, as they had already already broken the diet half a dozen times and it wasn't even March yet. Who fails at dieting?
A. Not enough information
B. The obese friend
C. The skinny friend
